verdict.rationale: Bench is a done-for-you bookkeeping service, so a close checklist is a fair axis for it. The evidence never shows an accountant-facing month-end close checklist tracking reconciliations, accruals, or review sign-offs. The nearest items are automatic merchant-fee reconciliation, generic task reminders and a tax filing-status overview; none is a close workflow, and the client-facing surface is reports and downloads.
